verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a Subscriptions API for creating subscriptions and an official MCP server so AI agents can call the Stripe API. Proration previews suggest plan changes are supported programmatically. However, the evidence shows nothing about applying credits or about scoped, least-privilege permissions for an agent. missing for 10: documented credit application (credit notes or customer balance) via API, scoped or restricted agent permissions, explicit plan-change API docs, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven billing operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my billing — create a subscription, apply a credit, change a plan — through a programmatic surface with scoped permissions

citations.quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
You can preview a proration to view the amount before applying the changes.
